question: Who is criticized as making a mockery of the Kula scripture?
premises: A seeker driven by greed is described.
Such a person is characterized as fickle.
This behavior is called a mockery of Kula scripture.
inference: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle makes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement of capalā with the subject is interpretive.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
